spans.s:
úd, prefix. never used alone; up, up forth,
out. [cf. AS. ūt, Eng. out: see uttara,
uttama.]

√ud or und (unátti; unná, uttá; -údya).
 —1. spring; boil or bubble up; flow;
 —2.
wet, bathe. [cf. Lat. und-a, ‘wave’; w.
ud-an, ‘water,’ cf. ὕδ-ωρ, Eng. wat-er; w.
ud-ra, ‘otter,’ cf. ὕδ-ρα, ‘water-snake,’
Eng. otter.]
+ sam, flow together; wet.
